angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 258,383 km at 24.72 pc = 0.14 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 40.4516 +/- 0.0359 mas (same row, RUWE 1.62): 24.72 pc, no zero-point correction; the RUWE is high, so the astrometry fits a single star poorly, and the parallax is used as published
radiusSource: Radius 0.3714 +/- 0.01 solar radii from Meier Valdés et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1468 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...698A..68M/abstract): 258,383 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.3527 +/- 0.0081 solar masses from Meier Valdés et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1468 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...698A..68M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3376 +/- 45 K from Meier Valdés et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1468 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...698A..68M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Meier Valdés et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1468 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...698A..68M/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-1468.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.846, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1468 (pscomppars): spectral type M3.0 V, from Chaturvedi et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...666A.155C/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1468 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.01 dex, from Meier Valdés et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...698A..68M/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1468 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.7921, from Meier Valdés et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...698A..68M/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1468 (pscomppars): rotation period 42.5 d, from Chaturvedi et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...666A.155C/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1468 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2 km/s, from Chaturvedi et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...666A.155C/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
